api_base.description: Conduct API base URL. The MCP endpoint is derived as <api_base>/mcp.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the Conduct check.

tool_name.description: Conduct tool name the prompt is evaluated under. Match the tool your rules target.

unreachable_fallback.description: Behavior when Conduct is unreachable, times out, or rejects the token.

workspace_id.description: Conduct workspace id, sent as the X-Workspace-Id header. Env: CONDUCT_WORKSPACE_ID.
